sar.narrative: This suspicious activity report concerns an undocumented coordinated fraud pattern, documented internally as AC-HHF-005. The activity involves customer C00348 and their debit Mastercard C00348-K1, along with 16 other connected cards: C00129-K1, C01326-K2, C03427-K2, C03488-K1, C03611-K2, C04274-K1, C04528-K1, C05083-K1, C05263-K2, C06198-K1, C09471-K2, C10035-K2, C10654-K1, C11332-K1, C12975-K2, and C13290-K1. On 2017-01-07 at 15:32, an online transaction for $4.30 (id 3660245, product code C) occurred in region 325.0. Subsequent online transactions on C00348-K1 include $5.08 on 2017-01-15 at 22:51 (id 3660246, region 264.0), $2.70 on 2017-01-16 at 14:04 (id 3660247, region 264.0), $4.94 on 2017-01-18 at 19:30 (id 3660248, region 264.0), $2.10 on 2017-01-20 at 11:03 (id 3660249, region 264.0), and the flagged $4.05 on 2017-01-28 at 20:45 (id 3660250, region 264.0). The customer C00348 reported that they did not make transaction 3660250. This pattern of six low-value online transactions across multiple days on card C00348-K1 is consistent with a coordinated low-and-slow micro-charge skimming ring affecting the aforementioned 16 other cards. The individual transaction amounts are significantly below the card's prior median amount of $58.98 and prior maximum amount of $774.08 over 150 prior transactions as of opening. No prior suspicious activity report has been filed on this card C00348-K1, and OFAC screening of the customer and card identifiers against the SDN list returned no match. An internal case AC-HHF-005 was created, monitoring of connected cards was initiated, and an escalation to an analyst was completed. A block of card C00348-K1 is recommended and awaits team-lead approval, and this report is recommended pending fraud-manager approval. The total suspicious amount for this episode is $23.17.
